author: M.K. Bryant
title: 'Jurassic Quest' coming to Birmingham in October - NewsBreak
text:
By M.K. Bryant ,
4 hours ago
BIRMINGHAM, Ala. ( WIAT ) -- "Jurassic Quest," an immersive dinosaur experience that offers hands-on learning, is coming to the Birmingham Jefferson Convention Complex in October.
One ticket will grant admission to three exhibits.
The first exhibit, "Jurassic Quest," will feature life-size moving dinosaurs, real fossils, dinosaur shows, rides, a soft play area and more.
The "Ancient Oceans" exhibit will feature prehistoric marine reptiles, educational displays and hands-on learning experiences.
The new 'Frozen Frontier" exhibit will feature multiple animals from the Ice Age and immersive exhibits.
Tickets and additional information can be found here .
